title: REQ · The CLI script reports the result and exits non-zero on failure
summary: runUntrack wraps untrackAndVerify for the npm script, logging results and returning an exit code
description: Context: scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts calls untrackNodeModules directly with no output and no verification. Desired behavior: a testable runUntrack(run, log, err) returns 0 and logs the count on success, or logs the error and returns 1; the script sets process.exitCode from it. Why: so the npm script gives a clear pass or fail.
acceptance_criteria: Given untrackAndVerify succeeds with before=3, when runUntrack runs, then log receives a message containing 3 and it returns 0
Given untrackAndVerify throws, when runUntrack runs, then err receives the message and it returns 1
Given the script, when run, then it sets process.exitCode from runUntrack
technical_constraints: Script keeps execFileSync('git') as the real runner
